lines.C01: [irritated, sharp] Marcel, not the ceiling. {{pause=0.2}} Me. {{pause=0.3}} [satisfied] Good. {{pause=0.3}} [smug, drawling] Welcome to Versailles. [delighted, self-admiring] Yes, I'm that handsome. {{pause=0.4}} [sneering, amused] Try not to faint.
lines.C02: [conspiratorial, proud] Some mornings, a hundred people watch me wake up. {{pause=0.2}} The ceremony is called the rising. {{pause=0.4}} [smug, with a soft laugh] I call it opening night.
lines.C03: [dry, bored] The doctor's here, the surgeon's here, and nobody came to see them. {{pause=0.4}} [smug, pleased] Everyone came to see me. {{pause=0.4}} [soft, satisfied] Naturally.
lines.C04: [brisk] Now, the wig. {{pause=0.3}} [mock-tragic, a small sigh] My hair started falling out at seventeen. {{pause=0.3}} [wounded pride] I took it personally, {{pause=0.2}} [dry, resolute] so I got a wig.
lines.C05: [smug] It makes me look taller, they say. {{pause=0.3}} [lofty] I wouldn't know. I never look down. {{pause=0.5}} [sighs contentedly]
lines.C06: [theatrical, savouring] White, grey, a little powder. {{pause=0.4}} [prophetic, grandly] One day, everybody will wear this. {{pause=0.4}} [mock-modest, chuckles] I'm just early.
lines.C07: [regal, bored] Bow. Lower. Good. {{pause=0.4}} [delighted, preening] Yes, this is the new wig. {{pause=0.3}} [arrogant] Take notes.
lines.C08: [contemptuous] A hundred people here, and none may speak before me. {{pause=0.5}} [tender, adoring] I love listening. {{pause=0.3}} [snorts a laugh] To myself, mostly.
lines.C09: [sharp, scandalised] Lower. {{pause=0.3}} Lower. {{pause=0.2}} [outraged whisper] Careful, that's a hat. {{pause=0.3}} [recovering haughtiness] Eyes on me, not on the hat.
lines.C10: [flirtatious, teasing] Red heels. Nobles only, {{pause=0.3}} [smug] and only the ones I like. {{pause=0.4}} [proud] Mine are the tallest, of course.
lines.C12: [grand, showman] Venice sold us mirrors. Now we have three hundred and fifty-seven of our own, {{pause=0.3}} [gleeful, laughs softly] and I'm in every single one.
lines.C13: [snapping, irritated] Don't stand behind me, you're ruining my reflection. {{pause=0.5}} [imperious, waving him off] Go. {{pause=0.2}} Over there. {{pause=0.2}} Further.
lines.C14: [mock-generous] Tonight I dine in public. You may watch, {{pause=0.3}} [firm] but don't stare. {{pause=0.4}} [sly, conspiratorial] Well... a little. {{pause=0.5}} [imperious, grand] Subscribe to my stunning channel.
lines.C15: [imperious, commanding] Hit like. {{pause=0.2}} Ring the bell. {{pause=0.4}} [dismissive, bored] Anyway, do what you like. {{pause=0.4}} [laughs, a cold, arrogant, haughty laugh, contemptuous] {{pause=0.4}} [gleeful, hungry] I'm off to the table to feast!
